fields.statement: QA: scratch builds of HEAD 9f005fded and of base 03b972942 (go build -trimpath, capped scope). In a scratch repo, apply --dry-run of four chained writes (add sso, add question, link to sso, set sso) gave the same output as base (IDs aside) and wrote nothing; the real apply then showed sso in slice and show. A garbage index file was rebuilt and status, change ls and render answered as before; an unopenable cache dir gives 'open index: ... permission denied' instead of a silent fold, as the leaf requires.

QA: scratch builds of HEAD 9f005fded and of base 03b972942 (go build -trimpath, capped scope). Every read op (status, inbox, change ls, slice, change show, overlaps) with an empty IndexPath (no HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME) gave the same bytes as with the index, in a clean log, with a damaged entry plus junk.json, and after a folder vanished; the chained dry run saw its earlier pending writes.

QA: scratch builds of HEAD 9f005fded and of base 03b972942 (go build -trimpath, capped scope). rhiza render (as-is) over the index in a scratch repo with a landed evidence node, a retired constraint and a retired link endpoint wrote files byte-identical to base's render and to the no-index render; slice and status in the main checkout matched base.

QA: scratch builds of HEAD 9f005fded and of base 03b972942 (go build -trimpath, capped scope). Scratch repo: render byte-identical to base 03b972942's and to the no-index path (diff -r), incl. evidence/logout-ev.md and 'constrains fast (retired)'; with an undecodable entry both refuse with the same 'damaged log, nothing rendered' error, exit 1; after a corrupt index, render reported 5 unchanged.

QA: scratch builds of HEAD 9f005fded and of base 03b972942 (go build -trimpath, capped scope). status, status --json and status --hook byte-identical to base in /home/rhiza/code/rhiza and in a scratch repo (clean, damaged log, vanished folder, no index). Warm in the main checkout: status 0.06 s (base 2.01 s), within 200 ms. --hook outside a repo: silent, exit 0; with an unopenable index: exit 0.

QA: scratch builds of HEAD 9f005fded and of base 03b972942 (go build -trimpath, capped scope). inbox and inbox --json byte-identical to base in /home/rhiza/code/rhiza and in a scratch root project with a failed run and overlapping in-flight change sets; with that run's change set folder deleted the item still lists, no error. Warm inbox in the main checkout 0.57 s (base 0.57 s; no target).

QA: scratch builds of HEAD 9f005fded and of base 03b972942 (go build -trimpath, capped scope). change ls and --json byte-identical to base in /home/rhiza/code/rhiza (6864 / 54880 lines) and in a scratch repo with a junk.json and an undecodable entry (both problems listed); after rm -rf of a draft change set's folder the warm index lists the rest with no stale one, same as base.

QA: scratch builds of HEAD 9f005fded and of base 03b972942 (go build -trimpath, capped scope). rhiza daemon --once in two scratch roots (base and HEAD) over a log with a proposed change set with a leaf, one without and two overlapping drafts: same output, both picked 'Proposed with leaf' for plan-review and skipped the leafless one; daemon status --json identical.

QA: scratch builds of HEAD 9f005fded and of base 03b972942 (go build -trimpath, capped scope). slice, slice --json, change show and --json byte-identical to base in /home/rhiza/code/rhiza (780 / 1266 lines for the current change set) and in a scratch repo (what-if with an in-flight overlap, after a vanished folder: 'no change set' as base). slice outside a repo: not_found, next rhiza init; change show with none current: the same usage error, exit 2.
